offering_description.value: Lennox designs and manufactures heating and cooling equipment for homes and commercial buildings, plus refrigeration equipment for food retailers and cold-storage operators. It supplies contractors through its own branches and independent distributors and provides installation and maintenance for commercial customers.

primary_products.value: Residential air conditioners and heat pumps; furnaces and air handlers; commercial rooftop HVAC units; commercial refrigeration systems; controls and replacement parts

primary_services.value: Commercial HVAC installation; preventive maintenance; repair

customer_segment.value: B2B: HVAC and refrigeration contractors, equipment distributors, commercial building operators, grocers and cold-storage operators; B2C: Homeowners buying heating and cooling equipment through independent dealers

end_markets.value: Residential HVAC replacement and new construction; commercial buildings; food retail; foodservice; cold storage

revenue_model.value: product sales: Heating, cooling and refrigeration equipment, controls and replacement parts; service fees: Commercial HVAC maintenance and repairs; project or contract: Commercial HVAC installation and scheduled maintenance agreements
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Builds HVAC and refrigeration equipment from components for contractors, distributors and commercial accounts; distributor: Stocks equipment and replacement parts for contractors at company branches; service provider: Deploys field technicians to install, maintain and repair equipment for commercial customers

geography_served.value: North America: Primarily the United States and Canada, with operations in Mexico

specialization.value: related lines: Residential heating and cooling, commercial HVAC and service, and commercial refrigeration

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: Independent equipment distributors, HVAC dealers and refrigeration contractors; own locations: Company-operated wholesale branches serving contractors; direct sales: Sales and service teams for national commercial accounts; online: Online equipment and parts ordering portal for contractors
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; own locations; direct sales; online

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: U.S. Department of Energy equipment efficiency standards and EPA refrigerant restrictions

notes: The extent of current sales outside North America is uncertain.
